name: filter each projection, then smear it back along its rays
mechanism: apply a ramp high-pass filter to each one-dimensional projection, then add each filtered projection back into the image along the rays that produced it; the filter cancels the blur that plain smearing would give

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Filtered back-projection' in section Computational mathematics / Numerical algorithms / Geometric: efficiently computes the inverse 2-dimensional Radon transform.

fails_when: few or noisy angles give streak artefacts
